newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai government revenue up 12.8 pct Oct-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Thai government revenue up 12.8 pct Oct-Aug.

text.p: The Thai finance ministry said on Friday government revenues from October 1995 to August 1996 rose 12.8 percent to 747.93 billion baht ($29.9 billion) from 747.28 billion baht in the previous corresponding period.
Thailand's fiscal year starts on October 1.
Government spending in the period totalled 684.71 billion baht against 567.63 billion baht in the previous period, the ministry said in a statement.
In the 11-month period, tax collection by the revenue department amounted to 446.31 billion baht or 2.59 percent higher than earlier projections, it said.
The excise department's revenue in the period was 153.42 billion baht or 0.67 percent higher than targeted.
